title: RUBRIC-ARROW: Alternating Pointwise Rubric Reward Modeling for LLM Post-training in Non-verifiable Domains
authors_zh: Haoxiang Jiang, Zihan Dong, Tianci Liu, Wanying Wang, Ran Xu, Tony Yu, Linjun Zhang, Haoyu Wang
paper_type_zh: Rubric 条件化点式奖励模型、Judge SFT 数据与后训练方法
best_for_zh: 需要构建开放式任务的 rubric Judge、点式奖励模型或偏好后训练流程的研究者。
one_line: RUBRIC-ARROW alternates rubric generation and pointwise judging to train reward models for non-verifiable tasks.
RUBRIC-ARROW 交替训练 rubric 生成器与条件化点式 Judge，为不可验证任务提供可学习的奖励信号。
why: It exposes a reusable rubric-conditioned judge data object instead of relying only on opaque frontier evaluators.
inclusion_reason: RUBRIC-ARROW releases rubric-conditioned judge SFT records for pointwise reward modeling in non-verifiable domains.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Non-verifiable writing, advice, and open-ended QA lack programmatic checkers, so a pointwise reward model must assign absolute scores to individual responses and is vulnerable to scale drift and subjective criteria. Rubric methods decompose requirements but often depend on expensive frontier models and sum Boolean satisfaction, producing many ties and weak gradients.

RUBRIC-ARROW jointly trains a rubric generator and rubric-conditioned judge, using probabilistic scoring and alternating GRPO to learn pointwise rewards from pairwise preferences, and releases judge-SFT data.

非可验证写作、建议和开放式问答缺少程序检查器，pointwise reward model 必须给单个回答绝对分数，却容易受尺度漂移和主观标准影响。rubric 方法虽能拆解要求，但常依赖昂贵前沿模型，并用布尔满足度求和，导致大量平局和弱梯度。

RUBRIC-ARROW 联合训练 rubric generator 与 rubric-conditioned Judge，用概率评分和交替 GRPO 从成对偏好中学习 pointwise reward，并公开 Judge SFT 数据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper releases RubricARROW-Judge-SFT with about 119,120 records containing instructions, rubrics, candidate outputs, and criterion-level or aggregate scores for training rubric-conditioned pointwise judges in non-verifiable domains. The algorithm alternates optimisation of a rubric generator and judge: the generator creates criteria that discriminate candidate quality, while the judge predicts satisfaction probabilities and aggregates them to reduce ties. RL uses only pairwise preferences rather than human absolute scores, converting paired feedback into interpretable single-response rewards.

论文公开 RubricARROW-Judge-SFT，约 119,120 条记录包含指令、rubric、候选输出与分项/总评分，可训练非可验证领域的 rubric-conditioned pointwise Judge。算法侧交替优化 rubric generator 和 Judge：前者生成区分候选质量的准则，后者输出每条准则满足概率，并以概率聚合减少平局；RL 阶段只需 pairwise preference，不要求人工绝对分。数据贡献和方法共同把成对偏好转成可解释的单回答 reward。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Construct judge-SFT data: Instructions, candidate outputs, and preferences are collected; atomic rubrics are generated and candidates receive criterion-level satisfaction and aggregate scores.
  1. Train initial components: SFT initialises the rubric generator and rubric-conditioned pointwise judge to produce criteria and probabilistic scores.
  1. Alternate GRPO: One component is fixed while the other is optimised: rubric rewards favour criteria that distinguish preferences, and judge rewards favour pointwise rankings consistent with pairwise winners.
  1. Train downstream policies: The probability-aggregated reward supports rejection sampling or RL post-training. Reproduction requires fixed preference data, rubric count, aggregation, and alternation schedule.

1. 构造 Judge SFT 数据： 收集指令、候选输出和偏好信息，生成原子 rubric，并标注候选对每条准则的满足程度与总分。
  1. 训练初始组件： 分别用 SFT 初始化 rubric generator 和 rubric-conditioned pointwise Judge，使其能生成准则并输出概率分。
  1. 交替 GRPO： 固定一方优化另一方：rubric 阶段奖励能正确区分偏好的准则，Judge 阶段奖励与 pairwise 胜负一致的 pointwise 排序。
  1. 下游策略训练： 将概率聚合 reward 用于 rejection sampling 或 RL 后训练。复现需固定偏好数据、rubric 数量、概率聚合和交替周期。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper compares pointwise, pairwise, and rubric baselines on reward-model benchmarks and downstream policy training. RUBRIC-ARROW achieves competitive reward accuracy and consistent gains across policy post-training settings. Probabilistic aggregation reduces ties created by Boolean sums, and ablations show that alternating updates of both generator and judge outperform training only one component. Because model scale, preference sources, and RL budgets affect outcomes, gains cannot be attributed entirely to the released SFT data.

论文在多个 reward-model benchmark 和下游策略训练任务上比较 pointwise、pairwise 及 rubric 基线。RUBRIC-ARROW 在奖励准确率上达到有竞争力结果，并在不同 policy 后训练设置中持续带来提升；概率聚合降低布尔求和造成的平局，交替训练消融表明 generator 与 Judge 共同更新优于只训练一方。由于模型规模、偏好来源和 RL 预算会影响结果，不能把全部增益归于公开 SFT 数据。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier rubric RMs typically have a fixed strong model generate criteria once and sum hard binary decisions, while pairwise RMs do not directly provide single-response rewards. RUBRIC-ARROW alternately improves criterion generation and judging under preference signals and replaces hard satisfaction with probabilities. The change is the co-learning relationship and reward form, not merely more rubrics.
既有 rubric RM 通常由固定强模型一次生成准则，再用硬 0/1 判断求和；pairwise RM 又难直接给单回答 reward。RUBRIC-ARROW 的新意是让准则生成和评分器在偏好信号下交替改进，并把满足判断改成概率分数。它改变的是 rubric 与 Judge 的共同学习关系及 reward 形式，而不是简单增加更多准则。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Self-generated rubric bias: The generator may omit real user requirements or create criteria tailored to training preferences. Critical domains need human audits of atomicity and coverage.
  1. Preference inheritance: Using only pairwise labels does not remove label bias; erroneous preferences train both criteria and judge.
  1. Training complexity: Alternating GRPO adds compute and instability. Reproduction must report sampling budgets, update ratios, and reward normalisation.

1. 自生成 rubric 偏差： generator 可能遗漏真实用户要求或生成迎合训练偏好的准则；关键领域需人工抽样检查原子性和覆盖率。
  1. 偏好继承： 算法只用 pairwise 标签并不会消除标签偏差，错误偏好会同时训练准则和 Judge。
  1. 训练复杂度： 交替 GRPO 增加计算与不稳定来源；复现必须报告采样量、更新比例和 reward 归一化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Non-verifiable RM training: Initialise a pointwise evaluator with the 119K judge-SFT records and alternate training on local pairwise preferences.
  1. Interpretable reward: Retain each rubric-satisfaction probability to explain why a policy response is rewarded or rejected instead of using one opaque score.
  1. Pipeline reuse: Validate a small rubric set with experts before automatic expansion in a new domain; do not let generator and judge reinforce each other without human anchors.

1. 非可验证 RM 训练： 使用 119K Judge SFT 记录初始化 pointwise evaluator，再用本地成对偏好交替训练。
  1. 可解释 reward： 保留每条 rubric 的满足概率，分析策略为何获奖或被拒，而不是只输出一个黑盒分数。
  1. 数据流程复用： 在新领域先由专家验证少量 rubric，再扩展自动生成；不能让 generator 与 Judge 在完全无人工锚点下互相强化。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: RUBRIC-ARROW alternately trains a rubric generator and pointwise judge from pairwise preferences to provide probabilistic rewards for non-verifiable tasks.
  1. Method takeaway: Judge-SFT initialisation, probabilistic satisfaction, phase-specific rewards, and alternating GRPO are central.
  1. Data takeaway: RubricARROW-Judge-SFT contains about 119,120 instruction–rubric–candidate–score records.
  1. Evidence anchor: The method improves RM accuracy and downstream policy post-training consistently, while probability aggregation reduces ties.
  1. Reuse decision: Best for open-ended reward modelling; audit rubric coverage, preference bias, and alternating-training stability.

1. 一句话定位： RUBRIC-ARROW 从 pairwise preference 交替训练 rubric generator 与 pointwise Judge，为非可验证任务提供概率 reward。
  1. 方法抓手： Judge SFT 初始化、概率满足度、分阶段 reward 和交替 GRPO 是核心。
  1. 数据抓手： RubricARROW-Judge-SFT 含约 119,120 条指令—rubric—候选—评分记录。
  1. 证据锚点： 方法在 RM 准确率和下游 policy 后训练上持续改善，概率聚合显著减少平局。
  1. 复用决定： 适合开放式任务 RM；使用前需审计 rubric 覆盖、偏好偏差和交替训练稳定性。
